{{Current events|year=2026|month=07|day=26|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****[[Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war]], [[Qatar as a mediator in conflict]]
*****[[Iran]] and the [[United States]] submit their responses to a proposal by [[Pakistan]] and [[Qatar]] to resume [[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations|talks]] between the two countries. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-903672 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] says it has prevented six ships from transiting the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/ukraine-strikes-iranian-vessels-tehran-accuses-kyiv-of-hostile-act.html (CNBC)]
****[[Mass media in Iran|Iranian media]] reports that an [[oil tanker]] exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after it has hit a [[naval mine]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/oil-tanker-explodes-after-hitting-naval-mine-hormuz-iranian-media (''Middle East Eye'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war]]
****Five aid convoys from the [[United Arab Emirates]] carrying 938 [[Tonne|tonnes]] of [[Humanitarian aid to Gaza|humanitarian aid]] arrive in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] as part of ''Operation Chivalrous Knight 3''. [https://www.gulftoday.ae/news/2026/07/26/five-uae-aid-convoys-carrying-938-tonnes-of-humanitarian-assistance-enter-gaza-strip (''Gulf Today'')] [https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2026/07/26/Ma17 (Sharjah24)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] states that an [[Hamas]] [[unmanned aerial vehicle]] unit commander was killed in an [[airstrike]] yesterday in central Gaza, in violation of the ongoing ceasefire. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-hamas-uav-commander-killed-in-gaza-strike-on-saturday/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
***[[Red Sea crisis]]
****Eleven vessels cross the [[Bab-el-Mandeb]] strait, according to shipping data from [[MarineTraffic|Kpler]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/red-sea-shipping-slows-after-houthi-attack-saudi-arabia-data-shows-2026-07-27/ (Reuters)]
***[[Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war]]
****The [[Houthis]] shoot down a [[Saudi Arabia]]n reconnaissance drone in northwest [[Yemen]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/yemens-houthis-say-they-downed-saudi-reconnaissance-drone/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] (SAF) announces that they have [[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|recaptured]] the [[North Kordofan]] areas of Umm Qarfa and Juraikh. The SAF also seize control of the National Export Highway ([[Omdurman]]–[[El Obeid]]), which connects [[Sudan]]'s capital [[Khartoum]] and North Kordofan. [https://sudanhorizon.com/sudanese-army-captures-new-areas-secures-full-control-of-national-export-highway/ (''Sudan Horizon'')] [https://sudantribune.com/article/316641 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Vietnam]]ese cargo ship {{mv|Khoi Nguyen 18||2}} sinks in the [[South China Sea]] along the Vietnamese coast. Forty-five people are rescued while 17 more are still missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/rescuers-scour-south-china-sea-23-missing-after-vietnamese-vessel-sinks-2026-07-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Brazil relations]]
**[[Brazil]] recalls [[Ambassadors of Brazil|its ambassador]] to [[Argentina]] and summons Argentina's ambassador after [[President of Argentina|Argentine president]] [[Javier Milei]] made remarks deemed derogatory about [[President of Brazil|Brazilian president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] and [[Supreme Federal Court|Supreme Court]] justice [[Alexandre de Moraes]] at a [[Politics of Brazil|political]] event in [[São Paulo]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260726-brazil-recalls-ambassador-to-argentina-over-milei-s-bolsonaro-rally-speech (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Iran–Ukraine relations]], [[Ukraine in the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign ministry]] summons the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[chargé d'affaires]] in [[Tehran]] over an attack by Ukraine on an Iranian ship in the [[Caspian Sea]] that killed an Iranian sailor, calling it a "hostile and criminal act". [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/26/ukraine-strikes-iranian-vessels-tehran-accuses-kyiv-of-hostile-act.html (CNBC)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Berlin Pride attack]]
**A suspect in a recent [[vehicle-ramming attack|vehicle-ramming]] and [[mass stabbing]] attack in [[Berlin]], identified as a 21-year-old [[Lebanese people in Germany|German citizen of Lebanese descent]], is shot and killed by [[Berlin Police|police]] after allegedly rushing toward officers with a weapon. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/25/europe/berlin-pride-car-intl-latam?utm_source=cnn_Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&bt_ee=hvT7886a5Jx0ZfMtt3QZEjY16i5CMu2Zbei7B%2FwATHXQejj4%2FIH4OjrUIGK9Mlw8KoMNZxE1HDX6BNwqTFzHSw%3D%3D&bt_ts=1785088407863 (CNN)]
*[[2026 Seattle Center shooting]]
**Three people are killed and four others are injured in a shooting during the annual [[Bite of Seattle]] festival in [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], United States. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/07/26/us/seattle-center-shooting-festival (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2027 Salvadoran presidential election]]
**[[El Salvador]]'s [[Nationalist Republican Alliance]] nominates former legislator [[Mayteé Iraheta]] for [[President of El Salvador|president]], while the [[Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front]] nominates physician Rafael Aguirre. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-opposition-pitch-former-lawmaker-doctor-run-against-bukele-2027-2026-07-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[List of International Space Station expeditions|International Space Station expeditions]]
**[[Expedition 74]], the joint [[NASA]]–[[Roscosmos]]–[[European Space Agency|ESA]] expedition aboard the [[International Space Station]], ends after the [[Soyuz MS-28]] undocks and lands on [[Earth]] in [[Kazakhstan]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/26/world/spacecraft-russians-american-intl (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Formula One World Championship]]
**[[2026 Bahrain Grand Prix]]
***In [[auto racing]], [[Formula One]] announces that [[Malaysia]]'s [[Sepang International Circuit]] will host the rescheduled [[Bahrain Grand Prix]] in October, under an agreement signed between [[Bahrain]] and Malaysia. [https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/26/malaysia-to-host-rescheduled-bahrain-grand-prix-f1-race-in-october (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/sports/formula1/malaysias-sepang-circuit-host-bahrain-f1-replacement-race-2026-07-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship]], [[Sports-related curses#Mayo|Sports-related curses]]
**In [[Gaelic football]], the [[All-Ireland Senior Football Championship]] concludes with [[Mayo county football team|Mayo]] defeating [[Kerry county football team|Kerry]] in [[2026 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final|the final]] to end one of sport's longest-running droughts and a 75-year wait for the title. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-07-27/mayo-wins-all-ireland-football-title-ending-75-year-curse/106960756 (ABC News Australia)] [https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/49456778/the-day-curse-mayo-ended-county-triumph-all-ireland-final-75-year-wait (ESPN)]

'''Culture'''
*The [[Alamut castle]] is added to the UNESCO World Heritage Site list. [https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/528556/Alamut-Castle-inscribed-as-Iran-s-30th-UNESCO-World-Heritage (Tehran Times)]
